_comment: REFERENCE ONLY — not a real run. Demonstrates the full ghl-ingest-agent v3 output structure. Every value is a [FILL: ...] placeholder. Real runs write /ingest/YYYY-MM-DD/ghl.json and ARE committed during the build phase. Arrays show one representative element each; real output has many. Tag and stage strings below are the VERIFIED live GHL names, byte-exact including trailing spaces (see .claude/agents/ghl-ingest-agent.md).
run_at: [FILL: ISO timestamp, America/Toronto offset — -04:00 in EDT, -05:00 in EST]

items.title: [FILL: New lead: name — scope, city (<=80 chars)]
items.summary: [FILL: 1-3 sentences. Source, what they want, whether tagged.]

items.title: [FILL: Unanswered: name (channel)]
items.summary: [FILL: 1-3 sentences. What they asked, what is owed, how long sitting.]

items.title: [FILL: Project WON: name | city]
items.summary: [FILL: 1-3 sentences. Stage moved from/to, pipeline, value, status.]

items.title: [FILL: Booked: name — in-home visit]
items.summary: [FILL: 1-3 sentences. When, visit type, how booked, prep needed.]

items.title: [FILL: Untagged in call queue 38h: name]
items.summary: [FILL: 1-3 sentences. Which workflow step was missed and what it blocks.]

items.title: [FILL: +N lower-priority items not itemized]
items.summary: [FILL: 1-3 sentences aggregating the overflow beyond the 50-item cap.]

metrics.new_leads: [FILL: number — created in window, NET of supplier-solicitation and spam; raw in reporting.exclusions]
metrics.unanswered_conversations: [FILL: number — NET of missed-call-no-voicemail and automated-system-log; raw in reporting.exclusions]
metrics.won_today: [FILL: number — (2) PROJECT: Sales Pipeline ONLY; store material in reporting.store_wins_today]
metrics.won_value_cents: [FILL: integer cents CAD — project pipeline ONLY]

needs_attention: [FILL: act-immediately item, e.g. payment pending on conversation X]
[FILL: drift item, e.g. 3 contacts in call queue untagged over 24h]

exclusions._comment: Reconciles the netted metrics back to raw. A netted metric with no visible raw is indistinguishable from a quiet day, so both halves ship. Excluded records are NOT dropped — they stay in conversations[] / new_leads[] carrying the flag that excluded them.
exclusions.new_leads_raw: [FILL: number — every contact created in the window]
exclusions.unanswered_raw: [FILL: number — every thread where next_response_owner is us]

reporting.store_wins_today: [FILL: number — 6a. Closed - Won, retail material. Kept OUT of metrics.won_today: a box of laminate and a $17K install do not belong in one figure]

leads_by_tag.untagged: [FILL: number — no lead:* tag, still in queue or nurture]

reporting.store_pipeline_note: [FILL: one line on STORE: Material Pipeline volume — retail material, distinct from project work. No stale thresholds defined for it]

stale_thresholds_used._comment: Echoed from platform-settings/ghl-workflow.json so the output is self-describing and a threshold change is visible in the diff.

meeting_window_summary._comment: The window any new Meeting-scheduled follow-up sequence must fit inside. Threshold counts from stage entry, so appointments booked far out shrink the usable runway.
meeting_window_summary.window_already_expired: [FILL: number — appointment booked so far out that stale fires before follow-up is possible; a workflow bug, not a rep failure]

new_leads.name: [FILL: name, or null if phone-only]
new_leads.qualification_tag: [FILL: lead: hot | lead: warm | lead: cold | lead: unqualified | lead: lost | lead: rate-shopper | untagged]
new_leads.timeline_field: [FILL: < 1 month | 1-3 months | 3+ months | Not Sure | null]
new_leads.tag_matches_timeline: [FILL: true/false — expected mapping held; false becomes a drift finding]

opportunities.pipeline: [FILL: (1) PROJECT: Lead Qualification | (2) PROJECT: Sales Pipeline | STORE: Material Pipeline]
opportunities.stale_threshold_days: [FILL: number for THIS stage from config, or null if the stage has none]
opportunities.pct_of_threshold: [FILL: number 0-1+ — days_in_stage / threshold. RANK ON THIS, not raw days: thresholds span 7-90 days so absolute days are not comparable across stages]
opportunities.days_remaining: [FILL: number until stale_lead, negative if overdue, or null]
opportunities.previous_stage: [FILL: exact stage name, or null if not moved]
opportunities.stale_risk: [FILL: none | approaching (>=75% of threshold) | stale | abandonment_next | not_applicable (stage has no threshold)]

appointments_booked.followup_activity_since: [FILL: true/false — any outbound touch after the appointment]
appointments_booked.days_stage_entry_to_appointment: [FILL: number — how much of the 30-day window was consumed before the visit]
appointments_booked.effective_window_days: [FILL: number — 30 minus the above; the real post-appointment runway. <=0 means stale fires before follow-up is possible]

conversations.channel: [FILL: sms | email | call | whatsapp | webchat | facebook | instagram]
conversations.contact_notion: [FILL: 1-3 sentence read of who this contact is and what they actually want, formed from the ENTIRE conversation history]
conversations.act_immediately_reason: [FILL: e.g. payment pending / install date at risk / insurance deadline, or null]
conversations.mismatch_note: [FILL: one sentence explaining the disagreement, or null. SIGNAL ONLY — never corrected in GHL]
conversations.followup_intent: [FILL: the intent driving the follow-up, or null]
flags: [FILL: payment-pending | insurance-claim | appt-cancelled | spam-suspected | supplier-solicitation | missed-call-no-voicemail]

workflow_drift.type: [FILL: untagged_in_queue | categorization_miss | followup_not_fired | stale_approaching | abandonment_next | meeting_no_followup]
workflow_drift.detail: [FILL: one sentence naming the workflow step that was missed]

won_records.pipeline: [FILL: (2) PROJECT: Sales Pipeline | STORE: Material Pipeline]
won_records.conversation_summary: [FILL: 2-3 sentences on how the conversation actually went — objections, what closed it]

stragglers_ranked.category: [FILL: payment | quote | scheduling | scope-change | categorization | supplier | other]
